title: TIA Project Spec
description: Structured engineering input the TIA harness turns into a compliant-by-construction, verifiable TIA Portal V21 project. Formalizes docs/TIA-BEST-PRACTICES.md §13.2. The user supplies engineering intent; the harness resolves real order numbers via GET /catalog and executes the creation pipeline. Connection params, IPs and order numbers shown in examples are illustrative — concrete order numbers MUST be resolved against the live installed catalog. This schema enforces SHAPE only; deterministic cross-field rules (same-subnet, unique names, module limits, language-by-family, the G5 safety rule) are enforced by the spec.validate skill on top of this schema.

project.description: Project-level identity and applicable standards. One project per machine/line whose devices must be coordinated (shared subnet, IO-systems, S7 connections, HMI<->PLC links). See §1.

name.description: Machine/line name. Used as the TIA project name. Prefer a meaningful, location/function-encoding name (e.g. 'Line2'), never 'Project_1'.

directory.description: Absolute path of the target directory for project creation. Guard Gd4: the directory must be EMPTY before project/create (the harness pre-checks). Windows path; escape backslashes in JSON.

standards.description: Applicable engineering standards driving structure and FDS. e.g. IEC 61131-3 (always), ISA-88/95/106 (batch/MES), IEC 61508/61511 (when safety is required).

conventions.description: Project-wide engineering conventions enforced uniformly. Defaults encode the §0 professional baseline (optimized access, 100% symbolic, right language per task). PLCopen is explicit that ANY documented naming scheme is acceptable — consistency matters more than the specific scheme.

namingScheme.description: Naming/prefix scheme applied uniformly and linted against. Configurable but enforced (the defensible product default). 'plcopen' = the PLCopen-style prefix scheme in §8.

optimizedAccess.description: Baseline §0: optimized block access is the default for every block (faster, symbolic-only, supports ARRAY[*] and IDB resize without download). Set false only for legacy absolute-addressing/pointer/AT interop, knowing it carries overhead.

symbolicOnly.description: Baseline §0: 100% symbolic addressing in logic — never hardcode M/I/Q or %DBx.DBXy.z. The single most-cited maintainability rule.

defaultLanguages.description: Default block language per concern (§4 language choice). LAD/FBD for binary interlocks, SCL for algorithms, GRAPH for sequencers. GRAPH/STL are S7-1500-only (validated by spec.validate against the target family).

devices.description: The stations to create (CPUs and distributed IO). Each is created via Devices.CreateWithItem(typeIdentifier, ...). Resolve every typeIdentifier against GET /catalog before building — never guess. At least one device is required.

network.description: PROFINET/IP topology. One PROFINET subnet (typically /24). HARD RULE (spec.validate): the PLC interface and ALL its IO-devices must share the SAME subnet. Device names are the PROFINET identity and must be unique and equal the HW-config name. See §3.

nodes.description: IP/IO assignment per device. Exactly one CPU node should set createIoSystem:true to host the IO-system its IO-devices join.

subnets.description: Optional explicit list of subnets when more than one is modeled. The primary subnet is usually given inline under network.subnet; list additional subnets here. Each subnet name must be unique.

dataTypes.description: PLC data types (UDTs). Baseline §0/§5: type EVERY block interface and every structured datum with a UDT. Import UDTs BEFORE the blocks that use them (Gd6). Keep nesting <= ~3 levels.

tags.description: PLC tags, split across purpose-specific tag tables (I/O, internal, HMI, constants — §6). Carry engineering units in comments. Never hardcode the resulting absolute addresses in logic (symbolicOnly).

tagTables.description: Optional explicit declaration of tag tables (names + purpose). If omitted, tables are inferred from the distinct 'table' values used by 'tags'. Purpose-specific split is the §6 rule.

functionalUnits.description: ISA-88 functional hierarchy mirrored in the program structure: unit -> equipment module -> control module. Each control module (a motor/valve/drive) becomes one reusable library FB TYPE with its own UDT interface (§1/§4).

reuse.description: Reuse strategy (§7). Prefer versioned library TYPES over master copies and over copy-paste. NOTE (low confidence): V21 Openness versioned-type update-to-latest may be manual; master copies are well supported.

library.description: Name of the central/global library that holds the company-standard types (e.g. 'CompanyStd').

types.description: Library types to use, in 'Name@major.minor' form (e.g. 'FB_Motor@1.2'). Bump major on a breaking interface change, minor otherwise.

hmi.description: Classic WinCC HMI (Comfort/Advanced/Professional). Build HMI tags by dragging PLC tags to keep the symbolic PLC-tag -> HMI-tag link; configure alarms on the tag via alarm classes; use faceplates as the HMI analogue of library types (§10). V21 supports classic-HMI screen round-trip only — NOT WinCC Unified.

faceplates.description: Reusable faceplate names (e.g. 'FP_Motor'). Central definition; instances inherit changes.

alarmClasses.description: Alarm classes defining display + acknowledgement policy.

ack.description: Whether alarms of this class require acknowledgement.

safety.description: Functional safety (F). SAFETY LOGIC IS SPECIFIED, NEVER AUTO-AUTHORED. Per IEC 61511 Management of Change, any F change is re-verified/validated/documented and signed off by a NAMED functional-safety engineer. RULE G5 (spec.validate): safety.required && autonomous => REJECT. The harness treats F as read-only/verification-oriented (§9).

required.description: Whether the project includes a safety (F) program. If true, F-logic is human-authored and gated (G5); selecting an F-CPU is allowed but authoring/downloading F is never autonomous.

sil.description: Target safety integrity level / performance level (e.g. 'SIL3', 'PLe'). Informational; drives F-CPU selection, not auto-authoring.

fRuntimeGroups.description: Number of F-runtime groups (a fail-safe OB calling a Main safety block). Max 2 (§9).

languages.description: Project (UI/comment) languages to enable in TIA, as culture codes (e.g. 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'de-DE'). Distinct from block programming languages (those live under conventions.defaultLanguages and blocks[].language).

blocks.description: Optional explicit program-block declarations (OB/FB/FC/global DB) when they are not derived from functionalUnits. Each declares its programming language, routed by the harness to SCL (textual) or SimaticML XML (graphical) per Gd6.

verification.description: Verification ladder configuration (§12). Rungs 0-3 are unattended (validate -> compile -> consistency -> simulate); rungs 4-6 (download/online/FAT-SAT) are gated. Clean compile is the precondition for export and download.

ladder.description: Which unattended rungs to run, in order. 'compile' and 'consistency' need only Openness; 'simulate' additionally needs PLCSIM.

tests.description: Machine-readable stimulus->expected test table for simulation (rung 3). Never assert on wall-clock scan timing (sim timing != hardware).

stimulus.description: Tag -> value map written before evaluation.

expect.description: Tag -> expected value map asserted after evaluation.

deployment.description: Gated download configuration (§14 gates G2/G3). Download forces a CPU STOP and is physically consequential — it always requires explicit human approval bound to a plan hash. The harness never auto-downloads.

approvalRequired.description: Must be true in any responsible config: download/online cross a hard human gate. The harness prepares the Load-Preview; a named operator confirms.

target.description: Target connection params. These strings vary per machine; a discovery step (online.accessibledevices) is usually needed first.

pcInterfaceName.description: PG/PC NIC name on the serve host (e.g. '<NIC>').

autonomous.description: Whether the caller intends fully autonomous execution through the gated rungs (download/online/safety). The harness is an assistant up to the gate, NEVER an autonomous commissioner. RULE G5 (spec.validate): if safety.required is true AND autonomous is true, the spec is REJECTED — F-logic can never be authored/downloaded autonomously (IEC 61511).

language.description: PLC programming language. LAD/FBD/SCL are valid on both S7-1200 and S7-1500; STL and GRAPH are S7-1500-ONLY (spec.validate rejects them on an S7-1200 target).

typeIdentifier.description: TIA device/module type identifier. EXACT shape: 'OrderNumber:<MLFB>/V<major>.<minor>' — a forward SLASH before V (a colon ':V2.9' is a known V21 drift bug and is rejected). MLFB and firmware are independent axes; resolve a concrete pair via GET /catalog (which returns typeIdentifierNormalized — pass that straight through). Example: 'OrderNumber:6ES7 511-1AK02-0AB0/V2.9'.

device.description: A station (CPU or distributed IO device) and its plugged modules.

name.description: Meaningful, UNIQUE device name encoding location/function (e.g. 'Line2_CPU', 'Line2_ET200SP_01'). This is also the PROFINET identity and must match the HW-config name. Uniqueness is enforced by spec.validate.

role.description: Logical role. Drives validation: a 'cpu' may host an IO-system and is subject to module-count limits and PTO/relay capability gates; an 'io-device' must share the CPU's subnet.

family.description: CPU/IO family hint used by spec.validate for module-limit and language-by-family checks (e.g. no STL/GRAPH on S7-1200; S7-1200 SM limits 0/2/8). If omitted, the validator may infer it from the MLFB.

outputType.description: S7-1200 output stage. Capability gate: high-speed on-board PTO/PWM is valid ONLY on DC/DC/DC (and 1217C differential). A 'relay' device requesting PTO is rejected early (§2).

modules.description: Modules plugged into this device (DI/DO/AI/AO/CM/CP/SB...). Subject to per-CPU expansion limits (S7-1200: 0/2/8 SM, 1 SB, 3 CM; S7-1500: up to 32). Count enforced by spec.validate.

module.description: A plugged module. order/typeIdentifier follows the same OrderNumber:<MLFB>/V<fw> contract as a device.

slot.description: Target slot. 65535 is the common 'next free' sentinel used in the §13.2 example.

kind.description: Module class, used to apply the right per-CPU expansion limit (SM vs SB vs CM/CP).

cidr.description: IP network in CIDR notation (typically a /24, e.g. '192.168.0.0/24'). Avoid overlap with corporate IT. spec.validate checks node IPs fall inside this network.

networkNode.description: One device's network attachment: its IP and whether it creates the IO-system. CPU + its IO-devices must resolve to the SAME subnet (same-subnet rule).

device.description: Name of a device declared under 'devices'. spec.validate checks this reference resolves.

ip.description: Static IPv4 address. Must lie within the subnet's CIDR (same-subnet rule). The controller assigns IPs at startup from resolved device names.

subnet.description: Optional explicit subnet name this node attaches to (defaults to network.subnet.name). Used when more than one subnet exists; the same-subnet rule is evaluated per resolved subnet.

createIoSystem.description: Whether this node (a CPU interface) creates the PROFINET IO-system its IO-devices join. Create one IO-system per controller interface (§3).

udt.description: A PLC data type (UDT). Type every interface/structured datum with one.

name.description: UDT name. UNIQUE among data types. PLCopen-style prefix 'UDT_' recommended (e.g. 'UDT_Motor').

members.description: Typed members. STRUCT for heterogeneous, ARRAY for homogeneous, ARRAY OF <UDT> for N identical objects.

dataType.description: Member data type (elementary, another UDT, ARRAY[..] OF ..., etc.). VARIANT/DTL/LTIME/WSTRING are version-gated — confirm against target firmware.

comment.description: Member comment; carry engineering units where applicable.

tagTable.description: A PLC tag table, split by purpose (§6).

table.description: Name of the tag table this tag belongs to (e.g. 'IO').

name.description: Tag name. Unique within its table; PLCopen-style prefixing recommended.

address.description: Absolute PLC address (e.g. '%Q0.0', '%I1.0', '%MW10'). Declared here for the tag table only — logic must reference the tag SYMBOLICALLY, never this literal (symbolicOnly).

unit.description: Engineering unit for the address comment (e.g. '%', 'degC'). Empty for digital signals.

retentive.description: Mark only truly persistent data as retentive — retentive memory is limited (§6).

functionalUnit.description: An ISA-88 unit and its equipment modules.

controlModules.description: Control modules (a motor/valve/drive). Each becomes one reusable library FB type instance with its own UDT interface.

libraryType.description: Library type backing this control module, 'Name@major.minor' (e.g. 'FB_Motor@1.2').

instanceDb.description: Instance DB name for this control module (e.g. 'DB_M01'). Prefer instance/multi-instance DBs (§4).

libraryTypeRef.description: Versioned library TYPE reference in 'Name@major.minor' form (e.g. 'FB_Motor@1.2'). Major bumps on breaking interface change, minor otherwise (§7).

kind.description: Block class. FB = unit of reuse/versioning (stateful, has IDB); FC = stateless utility (data via params); DB = data (minimize global DBs).

language.description: Programming language. Routes the harness (Gd6): textual (SCL/STL) -> /source; graphical (LAD/FBD/GRAPH) -> SimaticML XML. STL/GRAPH are S7-1500-only.

optimized.description: Optimized block access for this block (defaults to conventions.optimizedAccess).
